candidates.name: Katie Hobbs
candidates.bio: Governor of Arizona since 2023 and formerly Arizona secretary of state.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs signed the repeal of Arizona's 1864 abortion ban (HB 2677, 2024)
source.quote: we should recommit to protecting women's bodily autonomy

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs barred county attorneys from prosecuting abortion providers (Executive Order 2023-11)
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs's energy taskforce recommends utility-scale wind and solar, and she seeks a 640-acre solar farm
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs joined the U.S. Climate Alliance (2023)
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs joined a multistate lawsuit over the EPA's repeal of a toxic air pollutant rule (2026), though she sought flexibility on ozone standards (2024)
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs seeks an income cap on Arizona's universal ESA vouchers and vetoed opting into the federal private school tax credit (2026)
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs directed state troopers to expand patrols with up to 14,000 hours of overtime (2026)
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs allocated more than $25 million for crime victims and violent crime prevention
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs expanded KidsCare and opposed the 2025 federal Medicaid cuts
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs joined a multistate public pharmacy collaborative offering discounted prescriptions (2025)
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs created Operation Desert Guardian to expand border security (executive order, 2025)
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs funded 50 state troopers for immigration enforcement but vetoed bills requiring local cooperation with ICE (2025)
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs opposes the 2026 ballot measure restricting public employee unions
source.quote: I grew up in a working-class family, and I am a proud union member.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs signed executive orders barring workplace discrimination by sexual orientation and gender identity (2023)
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs vetoed a bill limiting which restrooms transgender students can use
source.quote: I will always stand up for your freedom to be who you are.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs signed the 2026 budget with a $1.4 billion middle-class tax cut and no state tax on tips and overtime
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs opposes business tax breaks and signed a three-year pause on a data center tax credit (2026)
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Hobbs vetoed SB 1001, which would have set ID requirements for voting by mail

candidates.name: Andy Biggs
candidates.bio: U.S. representative for Arizona's 5th District since 2017 and a former president of the Arizona Senate.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs sponsored the Life at Conception Act (H.R. 722), which would ban abortion nationwide
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs on the overturning of Roe v. Wade
source.quote: a major victory for the unborn

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs voted against the 2022 clean energy investments, to repeal them in 2023 and to end the tax credits in 2025
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs voted to overturn a Labor Department rule letting retirement managers weigh climate risk (H.J.Res. 30, 2023)

guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs voted to undo limits on seven hazardous air pollutants (2025) and to end mining limits near the Boundary Waters (2026), and opposed stricter air pollution limits for Maricopa County
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs would fully fund public safety departments
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs would fully fund public safety departments
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs introduced mandatory minimum sentences for certain crimes in Washington, D.C. (H.R. 5172)

guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs introduced H.R. 83 to let federal funds follow low-income students to private or charter schools and would expand Arizona's universal ESA vouchers
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs introduced a bill to repeal the ACA (H.R. 114), calling it a complete failure, and voted against extending its subsidies (2026)
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs would fund and complete the border wall
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs supports mass deportations and wants federal and local police to partner on border security
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs voted in 2021 against a path to permanent residency for Dreamers (H.R. 6)
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs voted against the PRO Act (2021) and against restoring federal workers' bargaining rights (2025)
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs voted against the Equality Act (House roll call 39, 2021)
guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs sponsored H.R. 28 to bar transgender students from girls' and women's sports
source.quote: denies the biological facts that men and women are the two genders

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs would eventually eliminate Arizona's income tax and pledged never to raise taxes
source.quote: I will never raise taxes on Arizonans.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Arizona governor voters guide: Biggs sponsored H.R. 7296, requiring proof of citizenship to register, and wants a Florida-style election law
